To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
cloud accounting suppliers should consider the impact of big data on AIS and the needs of users when designing and implementing cloud AIS products.

the cloud accounting AIS is a kind of cloud accounting service that is provided to the enterprise users by the cloud accounting suppliers through the Internet, which can provide the users with a series of accounting information services such as financial accounting, management accounting, tax accounting and cost accounting.
the cloud accounting AIS product is the core of the enterprise's accounting information system.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the demand evolution of cloud AIS, which is helpful for cloud accounting suppliers to provide more effective and efficient cloud accounting services.
the development trend of cloud accounting and the demand evolution of cloud AIS.
how to build AIS under big data environment, how to evaluate the AIS products of big data cloud accounting, and how to provide effective support for the decision-making of enterprise users.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the cloud accounting AIS is the inevitable choice for enterprises, and the AIS products provided by the cloud accounting suppliers can effectively meet the needs of enterprise accounting information management.

the cloud AIS products provided to enterprise users by cloud accounting suppliers have the characteristics of cloud AIS and the credibility of the cloud AIS products can be improved by the cloud accounting AIS product structure.

the cloud accounting AIS can effectively improve the efficiency of accounting work, and the cloud accounting suppliers can improve the credibility of cloud AIS products through the structural eigenvalues of cloud AIS products.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

this paper has established the implementation framework of cloud accounting AIS and proposed the management methods based on the structural eigenvalue of complex network, which has certain reference value for cloud accounting suppliers to improve the competitiveness of their products.

the cloud AIS products provided in this paper can provide effective support to the enterprise's financial decision, and the management methods proposed in this paper can help cloud accounting providers to improve their products and services.
this paper has provided a theoretical basis for the development and application of cloud accounting AIS in the era of big data.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we propose a new method of cloud accounting AIS products, and provide a new way to build cloud accounting AIS.
the AIS products of the cloud accounting can be modeled as a complex network and can be analyzed by using the structural eigenvalue.
we have proposed a framework of cloud accounting AIS, which is based on the analysis of cloud accounting and the impact of big data, and has been applied to the actual cloud accounting AIS products.
